newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin eyes Russian venture - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin eyes Russian venture - NYT.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp is expected to announce it is forming a joint venture with a Russian organization to offer satellite communication services, the New York Times said.

In Monday's edition, the Times said the venture, with Intersputnik International Organization of Space Communications, was intended to initially provide broadcast telecommunications to Eastern Europe, Africa, parts of Asia and the former Soviet Union.

Unnamed sources familiar with the venture said the company hopes it will generates between $300 million and $500 million in annual revenue by 2001. The first satellite is expected to be launched in late 1988.
